dct_description_sm: Oman administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 11 Governorate - Admin 2: 63 Wilayat Note: Names have the unit type (Governorate, Wilayat, محافظة, ولاية) removed in English and Arabic. Al Jabal Al Akhdar (OM0509, English and Arabic) and Jaalan Bani Bu Hasan (OM0803, Arabic) are spelling-corrected from the source. P-codes follow NCSI's IDs and share no codes with v01. Dates associated with this dataset: - 09 November 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 09 November 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 05 October 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 08 January 2023: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI), Sultanate of Oman
